issues.evidence: The descriptive text 记下页码和一句原文。 uses color #454D5A on white, while nearby labels 书签/重读 use #14181E; the body copy reads noticeably lighter than the labels despite carrying the actual explanation.
issues.suggestedChange: Darken body text-0/text-1 toward the label color, or reduce the gap between label and body weight so the explanation reads as primary content.
